definitions.explanation: The hair that grows in the armpit area.

examples.japanese: {夏|なつ}になると{脇毛|わきげ}の{処理|しょり}が{気|き}になる。
examples.english: When summer comes, I start worrying about dealing with my armpit hair.

examples.japanese: {日本|にほん}では{女性|じょせい}が{脇毛|わきげ}を{処理|しょり}するのが{一般的|いっぱんてき}だが、{国|くに}や{文化|ぶんか}によって{考|かんが}え{方|かた}はさまざまだ。
examples.english: In Japan, it is common for women to remove their armpit hair, but attitudes vary depending on the country and culture.

notes:
A compound of {脇|わき} (armpit, side) and {毛|げ} (hair). A straightforward body-related vocabulary word. In Japan, hair removal ({脱毛|だつもう}) is a major industry, and {脇毛|わきげ} processing is one of the most common services at hair removal salons.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {脇毛|わきげ}を{剃|そ}る: to shave armpit hair
- {脇毛|わきげ}の{処理|しょり}: armpit hair removal/grooming
- {脇毛|わきげ}の{脱毛|だつもう}: armpit hair depilation
- {脇毛|わきげ}が{生|は}える: armpit hair grows

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {腋毛|えきもう}: armpit hair — the formal/medical term using on'yomi readings
- {体毛|たいもう}: body hair — the general term for hair on the body
- {脛毛|すねげ}: leg hair; shin hair — another common body hair term
- {胸毛|むなげ}: chest hair — hair on the chest
